_readme: Team names + default rules. Anything you omit here falls back to DEFAULT_RULES in scripts/game_data.gd. Everything is editable in the Setup screen too - this file only sets the DEFAULTS.

_rules.answer_columns: 0 = pick automatically from the number of answers on the board.
_rules.first_round_starter: 0 = first team listed always, 1 = second team always, 2 = alternate every round.
_rules.guesses_per_round: How many guesses a team gets on one board before the round is forced to end.
_rules.seconds_per_guess: Countdown per turn. Set to 0 to switch the timer off.
_rules.strikes_per_turn: Wrong answers in a row before the turn is handed to the other team.
_rules.tie_breaker_enabled: When true, a tie after the last round is settled with the tie-breaker board.
